title: A chain whose anti-rug allowlist verification failed at boot

options.name: Keep current behaviour: resumed positions on that chain are not re-registered, but new buys arm anti-rug against the unverified list; both only logged
options.risk: Inconsistent protection on one chain, invisible except in logs (AUD-ANTIRUG-008).

options.name: Monitor everything with the merged list anyway (a failed RPC call is not a bad list) and send a Telegram alert
options.behavior_impact: All positions are protected; the operator is told verification did not run.
options.risk: An env-overlay typo that verification would have caught (an EOA) becomes an active allowlist entry.

options.name: No new buys on that chain until verification passes; alert; keep resumed positions monitored with the hardcoded list only
options.behavior_impact: The chain stops entering positions until RPC recovers.
options.risk: Missed entries while the RPC is flaky.

recommendation: monitor-all-alert, with verification retried in the background.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract).
behavior_impact: Decides how a failed boot verification affects protection and buying on that chain.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
